content.short: OpenGDP Shared Security provides a modular network stack for creating dedicated chains with shared validator security.
content.description: OpenGDP Shared Security is part of the OpenGDP Network Stack, a modular architecture for developers, enterprises, and institutions that want to launch dedicated blockchain networks. The stack emphasizes full-stack customizability, no-inflation network creation, instant validator sets, and shared security backed by blue-chip crypto assets and real-world assets. Its security model validates data at header, block, and transaction levels while enforcing runtime safeguards. On Mantle, OpenGDP brings shared-security infrastructure for applications that need dedicated execution environments with stronger validator guarantees.
